pages.text: $(thing)Fire curing$() is activated by placing the Drying Rack directly above a $(item)lit Campfire$(). The rack detects campfire blocks, including the soul-campfire form.

Fire curing takes $(item)24,000 ticks$(), about $(item)1 Minecraft day$(), making it the fastest curing method. Because Fire has highest method priority, a lit campfire directly below the rack overrides flue, sun, and air conditions.
pages.title: Time and Priority

pages.text: If you want a clean single-method cure, do not light the campfire partway through some other cure. Method switching can reduce final quality even if the batch eventually finishes successfully.
pages.title: Consistency
